usage.useWhen: One point on a spotlight image with a name and a short text. x and y place it in percent of the image from the start edge and the top; leitvia/update-block moves it with attributes x and y, for example after the image changed.
usage.avoidWhen: Outside a spotlight; it only works as its child.
usage.a11y: The name must describe the point without the image, for example Charging port instead of Point 1.
